nativeText: Isilimo esithi Amadumbe (taro) sikhethiwe, kodwa asinayo inyanga yokuhlwanyela ekhalendeni elisetshenziswa yileli pulazi: ikhalenda lemvula yasehlobo nesithwathwa esinamandla. Buza isikhulu esikweluleka ngezolimo ngaphambi kokuzama lesi silimo lapha.

Akukadwetshwa indawo yokulima emephini, ngakho ibingekho indawo yokubeka imifino oyikhethile. Dweba umbhede wemifino emephini bese ucela isiphakamiso futhi.

Zonke izindawo zokulima emephini yakho ziyiziza zezilimo zokudla okuyisisekelo, futhi imifino oyikhethile idinga umbhede wemifino ojwayelekile. Dweba umbhede wemifino emephini, noma uzitshalele yona esizeni ngemva kokuhlola ukuhlelwa kwemigqa.
Ayisekho imibhede ekhululekile yezilimo zokondla umndeni ngemva kokubekwa kwezilimo ezisabalalayo ezidinga indawo enkulu.

Ukuhlelela zona kanye izilimo ezikhethiwe kudinga ubude besikhathi sokukhula nendlela yokuziqalisa ensimini okuqinisekisiwe. Izilinganiso zesivuno zisetshenziswa kuphela lapho zikhona kukhathalogi; amakhilogremu angekho awaqanjwa.

Ukukhetha okuzenzakalelayo okubanzi kusebenzisa izilimo ezinesivuno, ubude besikhathi sokukhula nezikhala zasensimini okuqinisekisiwe ukuze ukuqhathaniswa kokukhiqiza kwazo kusekelwe ebufakazini obufanayo.

Indawo yokulima engu-1 inesikhathi esingenakho ukuhlwanyela okusha: PRIVATE {note}, east; $& (unyaka wonke). Isiza sezilimo zokudla okuyisisekelo sikhulisa isilimo esisodwa kuyo yonke indawo yaso. Uma umjikelezo waso wokulima wonyaka ususetshenzisiwe, akusalandeli esinye isilimo sokudla okuyisisekelo. Asikho isilimo esikhethiwe sokumboza umhlabathi ebusika esifinyelela kulezi zinyanga. Isilimo semifino singagcina umhlabathi utshaliwe ngalezo zinyanga, kodwa uhlelo ngeke luzifakele imifino ensimini edwetshwe emephini — uma itshalwa ngobubanzi bensimu yonke, lokho kudinga ukuzibophezela okukhulu, ngakho isinqumo sishiyelwa wena. Ukuhlwanyela ngesandla, noma ukushiya umhlabathi uphumule, kokubili kuyizinketho ezifanele.
